title: 에다가: 가방에다가 넣으세요
objective: By the end, you can use N에다가/N에다 to say where something goes (put, attach, write) and what you add to it. You can also tell when to use 에, 에게, or 에서 instead.
summary: This worksheet teaches the particle 에다가 (short form 에다), which marks where you put, attach, or write something, or what you add something to.

task.title: Use 에다가 correctly
task.line: Read each item and choose, fill in, correct, order, or answer in Korean as the instruction says.

forms.when: With verbs of putting, attaching, or writing (넣다, 놓다, 두다, 붙이다, 쓰다, 적다). It has the same form after nouns with or without a final consonant.
forms.means: in / on / at (the place where a thing ends up)
forms.exampleMeaning: Put your wallet in your bag.

forms.when: In everyday speech. It means the same as 에다가.
When you add one thing on top of another. It often comes with 까지 or 도.
forms.exampleMeaning: I had coffee and cake on top of that.

forms.when: With putting verbs, both are correct. 에다가 points more clearly to the exact spot and is common in speech. Use only 에 for going, coming, or being somewhere.
forms.means: 에 = in/at/to (general); 에다가 = right there, in/on that spot
forms.example: 옷은 바닥에 두지 말고 옷걸이에다가 거세요.
forms.exampleMeaning: Don't leave your clothes on the floor. Hang them on the hanger.

watchOut: 학교에다가 가요 (X) → 학교에 가요 (O): With going, coming, or being somewhere, use only 에.
친구에다가 줬어요 (X) → 친구에게 줬어요 (O): For people and animals, use 에게, not 에다가.
공책에서 쓰세요 (X) → 공책에다가 쓰세요 (O): The place where a thing ends up takes 에다가 (or 에), not 에서.
exercises: Choose the right word: ① 반찬은 냉장고(에서 / 에다가) 넣어 두세요. ② 저는 매일 도서관(에다가 / 에) 가요. ③ 동생(에게 / 에다가) 선물을 보냈어요.
Fill in the blank with the short form: 택배는 문 앞____ 놓아 주세요.
Fill in the blank with the particle that means 'on top of': 이번 주에는 숙제____ 시험공부까지 해야 해요.
Write O if the sentence is correct. If it is wrong, write X and correct it: ① 휴대폰을 책상 위에다가 놓았어요. ② 주말에는 보통 집에다가 있어요. ③ 포스터를 게시판에서 붙였어요.
Put the words in order: 적어 두세요 / 전화번호를 / 수첩에다가
Answer in Korean with 에다가. Your friend asks you this, and you point to the trash can (쓰레기통): 이 쓰레기 어디에 버려요?
answers: ① 에다가 ② 에 ③ 에게
① O ② X → 주말에는 보통 집에 있어요. ③ X → 포스터를 게시판에다가 붙였어요. (게시판에 붙였어요.)
수첩에다가 전화번호를 적어 두세요. (전화번호를 수첩에다가 적어 두세요.)
